qualification_rule: No geometry transform may use an AMBIGUOUS or UNKNOWN semantic mapping.

layers.reason: The PDK identifies this as a mask-add record, but gives no boolean equation or electrical-view generation procedure. The GDS-only Magic technology preserves it as LIBLOCK-like data and expressly is not an extraction technology. A name resemblance to LI1 is not semantic proof.

The installed Magic GDS-only technology calls 22/21 CNTMADD, while the pinned SkyWater GDS layer table calls the same record 'cfom, mask add'; the actual CNTM mask-add record is 26/21. This naming conflict and the absence of a transform equation make any contact or field-oxide mapping unsafe.

The PDK identifies a CP1M mask-add record but supplies no topology-preserving composition equation. The GDS-only Magic technology preserves it as POLYBLOCK-like data and cannot establish that it should be ORed into drawn poly.

layers.category: standalone drawn implant and device-classification geometry
layers.composition_operation: No materialization transform. The pinned LVS deck subtracts NCM regions while deriving standard/HVT/HV gate classes.
layers.composition_order: device derivation in LVS, not SRAM add-mask materialization
layers.reason: SkyWater masks.csv, gds_layers.csv, the layer-description table, and design-rule assumption tables identify NCM as N-Core Implant. The pinned KLayout LVS deck reads 92/44 directly and uses it in gate classification. It is not an alias for LI, a contact, or poly.
